title: After marking a single notification read, it no longer counts toward unreadCount on the next fetch
preconditions: User has at least 2 unread notifications
steps: Note the current data.unreadCount from GET /notifications/client
PUT /notifications/{id}/read for one of the unread items
expectedResult: The second call's unreadCount is exactly one less than the first, and the notification's isRead is true with readAt populated.

title: After mark-all-read, the unread-count endpoint returns 0
expectedResult: data.count is 0 immediately after mark-all-read, with no residual unread items left over from a race between the two calls.

title: A deleted notification no longer appears in a subsequent client list fetch
preconditions: User has at least 1 notification to delete
expectedResult: The deleted notification's id is absent from data.notifications, and pagination.total decreases by 1.

title: A notification dispatched with sourceModule='vendor' resolves to moduleLabel 'Vendor' on the client
description: Sanity check for normalizeNotification()/resolveSourceModule() in notificationNormalizer.js after any change to the dispatch payload shape.
preconditions: Ability to dispatch a test notification with sourceModule='vendor' (e.g. via /notifications/send or internal endpoint)
steps: Dispatch a notification with sourceModule='vendor' to the current user
Open NotificationMenu / NotificationDrawer and inspect the rendered entry
expectedResult: The client-side normalized notification has moduleLabel = 'Vendor' (from MODULE_DISPLAY_LABELS), confirming sourceModule takes priority over metadata.module/navigateTo-derived fallback.

title: A low-priority 'general' notification is excluded from surface=popup but present in surface=drawer
preconditions: A fresh unread notification with notificationType='general' and priority='low' (or default 'medium') is dispatched to the user
expectedResult: The popup response's notifications array does not include the general/low-priority item; the drawer response does include it — confirming the popup filter (priority high/critical OR actionable notificationType) is applied only to the popup surface.
